description: This file defines classes and types related to data elements, including DataStore, DataElement, LinkedDataElement, and DataElementParser, used for managing binary data buffers, serialization, and memory alignment within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: Manages a dynamically allocated buffer with methods for copying data, resizing, and accessing the buffer.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data buffer with methods for reading, writing, searching, and manipulating binary data, supporting different endianness and memory alignment.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Extends DataElement to support linked list of data buffers, allowing concatenated or segmented data management.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Provides sequential access to a DataElement, enabling reading, searching, and setting data with position tracking.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the DataStore buffer.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal buffer.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns or sets the size of the DataStore buffer.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates internal cache with data from another DataElement or buffer.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the DataElement to an empty state.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the buffer to the specified type's alignment.

methods.name: AllocatedSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum allocated size.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the DataElement has a valid buffer.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the data.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the storage proxy.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a byte at a specific index.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a range of bytes to a specific value.

methods.name: Expand
methods.description: Expands the data buffer at a specific offset.

methods.name: Shrink
methods.description: Shrinks the data buffer at a specific offset.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another DataElement into this one.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a byte pattern within the data.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a number of a specific type from the data at a given offset, considering endianness.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number of a specific type into the data at a given offset, considering endianness.

methods.name: GetBitNumber
methods.description: Retrieves specific bits from the data.

methods.name: SetBitNumber
methods.description: Sets specific bits within the data.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Copies a buffer into the data at a specific offset.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Sets the size of the data buffer, possibly reallocating.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another DataElement or LinkedDataElement.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a range of data.

methods.name: Reallocation
methods.description: Handles buffer reallocation when resizing.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Copies a range of data into a provided buffer.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Returns the next linked data element.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Sets the next linked data element.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns total size including linked elements.

methods.name: LinkedElements
methods.description: Returns the count of linked elements.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number pattern across linked elements.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a number from linked data, possibly crossing boundaries.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number in linked data, possibly crossing boundaries.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Copies data from linked data into a buffer.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Copies data into linked data from a buffer.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another linked data element.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns or sets the size of the parser's current position.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Advances the parser position.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number pattern in the data.

methods.name: GetNumber

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves a buffer segment from the data.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number in the data.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets a buffer segment in the data.
